## Problem and change

Explain the concrete problem, the smallest useful change, and any primary sources.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. For compatibility or evaluation claims, include the host/version and limitations.

- [ ] Agent Skills schema and package checks pass.
- [ ] Guidance and evidence match the change; unperformed checks are identified.
- [ ] No generated trial projects, private logs, credentials, or handoff notes are included.
